title: Distance over many frames
prompt: Return the total distance covered at speed over a number of frames that each last delta seconds.
signature: func solve(speed: float, delta: float, frames: int) -> float:
starter:
func solve(speed: float, delta: float, frames: int) -> float:
	return speed * delta
hint: Distance per frame, times the number of frames.
solution:
func solve(speed: float, delta: float, frames: int) -> float:
	return speed * delta * frames
